facts.fact: 闻儿子要留下住，Joel 只回了句「我们都该歇歇」。
facts.anchor: We could all use a break. That’s what Joel said when I told him Roddie wanted to stay with me until further notice.

facts.fact: Meg 自查清单：记账像黑帮收账、常年工作/接送/回维多利亚、明知疏远却无所作为——离婚不能全怪 Joel。
facts.anchor: I ran our chequing account like I was collecting for the mob.

facts.fact: 她不恨人、恨他的自私 streak；对敢怼 Joel 的 Wanda 反而心生敬意（自己当年从不敢要求分工）。
facts.anchor: So no, I didn’t hate him—I hated his selfish streak.

facts.fact: 她承认自己把 Joel 训练成「危机结束后才被知会」的旁观式父亲——他因此以为带娃没有紧急状态。
facts.anchor: I’d trained Joel to expect me to run triage with the kids and only loop him in once the crisis had passed—when he had time to absorb and process it.

facts.fact: 摊牌照做：辞职帮 Georgia 看店、对方待手术；Roddie 确认与自己无关后先松一口气。
facts.anchor: I’m helping Georgia at her shop. She needs surgery.

facts.fact: 店名揭晓「成人玩具」，她秒切公关腔：sexual health store、多元客群——顺手把母亲推下公交车（Downtown Express with both hands）。
facts.anchor: Afternoon Delight is a sexual health store that serves the needs of a diverse customer base. Grandma’s been helping me there.

facts.fact: Roddie 回敬：「卖点不就是让人兴奋吗——我就是个小孩懂什么」，边说边把面条铲进得意的嘴。
facts.anchor: “I think the point is to get excited, but what do I know?” He shovelled more noodles into his smirking mouth. “I’m just a kid.”

facts.fact: Roddie 吐槽「亲妈出柜成地牢主自然想告诉朋友——可惜我没有朋友」，怒瞪盘子（Tyson/Bethany 余波）；Meg 求他保密几天。
facts.anchor: When your mom comes out as a dungeon master, you kind of want to tell your friends. But since I don’t have any...
